shared_elements: central vertical axis or frontal symmetry
horizontal band of repeated curved marks
justification: The main correspondence is only a broad one: both use schematic incised/relief linear motifs arranged roughly symmetrically, including curved/arched lines and a horizontal band of repeated curves. The biggest difference is that A depicts a frontal anthropomorphic body with face, breasts, circular features and torso bands, while B depicts an enclosed angular emblem or boat-like form above a wave-like band, with no clear matching human-body iconography.
